short_description: Networking, career development and socials for students interested in accounting, finance and more.
long_description: The Accounting & Finance Society is one of the leading societies at The University of Liverpool. We are a student-led society dedicated to enhancing your university experience both academically and socially. We host networking events and promote graduate and placement opportunities to give our members the best chance of securing and succeeding in competitive industries. Alongside this, we run a strong social calendar including pub trips, society nights, formals and other events designed to bring together students across all years. Whether you study Accounting, Finance, Economics, or simply have an interest in the industry, join us and be part of the community. Follow us on Instagram at UOLACFI to get involved.

short_description: AeroSoc is the Aerospace Engineering Departmental Society at the University of Liverpool, run by students for students.
long_description: AeroSoc is the Aerospace Engineering Departmental Society at the University of Liverpool, run by students for students. We provide a community for those studying Aerospace Engineering, as well as for those who have a general interest in the field. Our goal is to bring people together through social events, educational trips, workshops, and fun activities. AeroSoc offers a variety of events throughout the academic year to create a sense of community and to help members learn and develop their skills. We aim to offer a variety of social and academic events such as pub crawls, movie nights, trips to aerospace-related companies and organizations, such as aircraft manufacturers, and workshops that focus on developing practical skills related to aerospace engineering and cover a range of topics, from aircraft design to programming and simulation. They are a great way for members to gain hands-on experience and to learn from experts in the field.

short_description: The University of Liverpool ACS, through producing interesting and exciting events that inspires and celebrates African and Caribbean culture.
long_description: The University of Liverpool ACS, through producing interesting and exciting events that inspires and entertains our members, aims to celebrate African and Caribbean culture and encourage excellence amongst our members during their time at university. We stand for unity and provide a comfortable, friendly and enjoyable environment for everyone and anyone to come and partake in experiencing afro-caribbean culture. From parties to career networking events, we as a society will provide opportunities you need to excel in your university career and enjoy thoroughly your time here at the University of Liverpool.

short_description: The AHP Society: everyone from Physio to Orthoptics. We run nights out and educational events to help you develop your interdisciplinary network whilst at uni.
Welcome to the American sports appreciation society! .
long_description: This is a society that brings people together for Great nights out and appreciate the American sports. We host socials including pub crawls, games nights (eg pool night) and watch the games when they appear. This society gives you plenty of chances to meet people and appreciate American sports. If Your a fan of the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, or any other American sports, we will also be watching the games together. Whether you Are a big fan or just getting into the games everyone is welcome. Come for the sports and join in on the socials, join us to be part of a great society. We announce our events on WhatsApp and instagram. Click here to join the community.

short_description: Amnesty International Society is a NGO that campaigns globally for human rights
long_description: Interested in justice, equality, and freedom? Join Amnesty International Society - a welcoming and inclusive community for anyone passionate about standing up for human rights and creating positive change, both locally and globally. We host open discussions, awareness events, and campaigns on current issues. Alongside this, we also hold regular socials and community events for memebers to meet like-minded people in fun ways. No prior knowledge or experience is needed - just bring an open mind!

short_description: The Anatomy Society is exclusively for students studying Anatomy and Human Biology to support them through their years at the University of Liverpool.
long_description: The Anatomy society is a close-knit community of students passionate about Anatomy and Human Biology! As part of the society, you will be able to attend regular socials, practice spotters to strengthen your knowledge, career events, a Christmas meal, and of course our annual Anatomy ball, where you can meet fellow students, staff, and overall feel supported throughout your degree. Follow our Instagram (@uolanatomy) for regular updates on events, and we look forward to seeing you through the year!

short_description: Love watching anime? Interested in seeing the latest releases in cinema with friends or going to cosplay conventions? Perhaps you've never seen any anime and want to find out what its all about?
long_description: At the UoL Anime and Otaku Society, we welcome newbies, casuals and die hard fans to join us in watching anime and celebrating otaku culture, occasionally over a pint too! You don't need to have watched every anime either to get involved, we know its slightly intimidating if youve never seen any anime to join a group thats all about anime but we aim to involve everyone and make sure that by the end of the year you'll have seen quite a few new titles! We announce most of our events on our Discord server, join here to keep up to date with what's on!

short_description: SACE is the society for ARCHAEOLOGY, CLASSICS AND EGYPTOLOGY, including Ancient History, Evolutionary Anthropology and Ancient Civilisations.
long_description: The official society for everyone studying within the ACE Department. We host socials, museum tours, cultural events, coffee and study meet ups and a host of other events year round. Students of all age, UG, PG, and staff welcome, as well as people who just have a general interest in the Ancient World and want to get more involved! Follow our Instagram @saceliverpool for up to date info and events.

guild_name: Artefacts: Liverpool Medical School Performing Arts
long_description: Fancy a break from the books and a chance to try something new? Has performing arts always secretly been in your blood? If so... Artefacts is for you! Still reading... here's more about us :) Established in 1962, UoL Medical School's Performing Arts Society is a fun and social way to meet medics (and non-medics!) from all year groups, and this time, it's in a different type of theatre! Whether it's drama, dance, choir, band or production you are interested in, we are looking for talented people to join our family and help us prepare for the annual Variety Show, Carol Concert and highly-anticipated second term musical. Artefacts brings everyone together to let off some steam, from the cellblocks of Chicago to Shrek's beloved swamp, our sold-out shows are often the highlight of the medical school calendar. With numerous socials throughout the year, you won't regret swapping your sterile gloves for jazz hands and adding another highlight to your university experience! Lots of Artelove x

short_description: Come and join the Liverpool Ballroom and Latin Society to learn and develop a new skill!
long_description: Welcome Dancers! Come and join the Liverpool Ballroom and Latin Society to learn and develop a new skill! We have weekly classes for people of all abilities, so if you've never danced before, or you've been dancing since you were little, we'd love to have you! We welcome students from all universities across Liverpool and ex-students! Not sure what lesson you should attend? This might help... Beginner: if you have never done Ballroom & Latin or have less than a year of dancing experience and have never competed. Learn how to ChaCha, Jive, Waltz and Quickstep! Open to All: non-core-4 dances including Samba, Foxtrot, Tango, Viennese Waltz, Rumba and Paso Doble! (suitable for all abilities) Novice: ChaCha, Jive, Waltz and Quickstep for returning novices and higher-level dancers. Technique: this is a great class for improving technique and is open to everyone. We offer our members the chance to compete against other universities up and down the country each year, and are honoured to host our very own competition here in Liverpool during semester 2! In addition to competitions, we occasionally perform within the university, such as at the University of Liverpool BSL Charity Ball last year! We are a lively, friendly club, and hold regular socials; last year this included pub crawls, craft evenings and game nights :) Follow our Instagram @liverpoolballroomandlatin for regular updates on classes, socials and more! So whether you are the next Anton Du Beke or have two left feet, you will find a home here in LBLS. We look forward to meeting you!

short_description: BandSoc is the society for you if you love all things music.
long_description: Welcome to BandSoc! Thanks for checking out our Guild page. If you'd like to join the society and get free access to our practice room, click "Add to Basket" above (it's free!) The best place to catch up with us is our Instagram, @bandsoc

short_description: We are the University of Liverpool Bar Society and our aim is to provide you with the necessary skills and experience to progress to the next stage of training in becoming a barrister.
long_description: We are the University of Liverpool Bar Society and our aim is to provide you with the necessary skills and experience to progress to the next stage of training in becoming a barrister. A career at the bar is highly competitive, with both BPTC providers and chambers seeking those who not only have the intellectual ability, but excellent advocacy skills and a wider awareness of what it takes to succeed. This means applicants are required to have experience in advocacy and Mooting, to undertake mini-pupillages/pro-bono work and to have knowledge of the profession through networking and observing cases in Court. As a member, you will gain all of this and more as we are the only legal society that is dedicated to the bar and will provide direct opportunities and information to improve your chances all year.

short_description: Welcome to the University of Liverpool Beatles Society!
long_description: BeatlesSoc is a place where all Beatles fans can get together. From die-hard fans to people who just want to find out more, this is the place for you. Follow us on Instagram for more info - @uolbeatlessoc

short_description: Welcome to the BioSciences Society!
long_description: Welcome to the BioSciences Society! We are here to allow a space for everyone to create more friendships and build upon a large science-based community. If you are up for a balanced lifestyle of working hard and having fun, this is the society for you. We organize study sessions for people to be immersed in a learning environment and have socials including a variety of activities.

short_description: The Black Students' Network is for self-defining black students. In the Network, black students can come together to socialise, make friends and give Student Officers feedback for the University.
Book Soc is there for you if you want to read collectively with a group of book enthusiasts.
long_description: Each month we're choosing a different theme for our books and socials, from mystery to mindfulness! If you finish a book NEEDING to discuss it with a friend, this is the society for you!

Hi! We are Liverpool Brick Society where we do all things lego! Come along to our chill sessions every week - chat, relax and get creative. We provide the bricks, you provide the creativity. Dates to be decided.

short_description: Butch Soc is a community made for butches, femmes, studs, stems, and those that love them!
We are a diverse group of students who meet to discover and learn how to share more about Jesus and his life changing message.
long_description: At the heart of CU is our aim of giving every student on campus an opportunity to hear and respond to the gospel of Jesus Christ. We also enjoy regular socials and sharing food and community together! https://www.liverpoolguild.org/shop/product/10045550/

short_description: We are a society dedicated to engaging with electronics and coding at all levels, from complete beginners to professional level.
long_description: We are a society dedicated to engaging with electronics and coding at all levels, from complete beginners to professional level. No coding nor electronics skills are require to join the society and we accept everyone regardless of year and course. Anyone can learn coding and electronics.

short_description: For fans of all types of comedies!
long_description: UoL Comedy Society is a place for people who enjoy all types of comedy: Sitcoms, Stand-up, improv, sketch and even aspiring comedians themselves! This society offers frequent socials which include trips to the famous Hot Water Comedy Club, Quizzes, Open-mic stand-up nights and much more! Whether you're a fan of comedy, want to learn more or are hoping to improve your skills, this society acts as a support and a place in which you can meet like-minded people to expand your interest. Instagram: @uolcomedysociety'

short_description: COMPSOC is one of the best societies in Liverpool. Don't believe us? Experience it yourself!
long_description: Liverpool Computing Society Building the future for those who are bored of blending in. COMPSOC is the University of Liverpool’s go-to CS, EEE and tech community. Join us for workshops, hackathons, guest talks and socials. Join Discord Follow Instagram Our Mission Liverpool Computing Society is dedicated to empowering students interested in technology. We organise workshops, industry talks, coding sessions and hackathons that help students develop skills, meet others in tech, and explore career opportunities. Collaboration We encourage students to learn together through projects, team hackathons and group workshops. Innovation From AI to web development, we explore the latest technologies and ideas shaping the future. Inclusivity We welcome students from all backgrounds and skill levels to explore computing together. Events & Activities Throughout the year we run technical workshops, industry talks, coding nights and large hackathons designed to help students build real skills and connect with the tech community. Liverpool Computing Society University of Liverpool © COMPSOC

short_description: Are you interested in creative writing?
long_description: Anyone with an interest in creative writing is welcome to this society to share, discuss, practise and improve their writing. Whether you enjoy novels, short stories, poetry, creative non-fiction, or screenwriting, we welcome you to meet others who also enjoy the craft. Our regular meetings for this semester are from 5-6pm in the James E Brown room in the Guild at these dates: January 27th, February 10th, Feb 24th, March 10th, April 14th, April 21st, May 5th.

short_description: Crown Place Halls’ Student Committee (HSC) is a committee of students living in Crown, who work to organise events and activities to make your time in Liverpool the best it can be!
long_description: You can get involved in your HSC by signing up on this page and emailing hsc@liverpool.ac.uk to let us know! Look out for your HSC's welcome meeting, which will take place on in the first week of term! HSC Training will take place on Wednesday 1st October - tickets will be listed here once they are available! Any questions? Email hsc@liverpool.ac.uk where the HSC team will get back to you as soon as possible!

short_description: Are you a cuber? Or do you want to learn how to solve a Rubik’s cube? The Cubing Society is open to anyone interested in learning, practicing, and chatting about cubing—all levels welcome!
long_description: Our aim is to build an active cubing community within the university. We run weekly cubing meetups where you can bring your own cubes or borrow from the society collection; other socials are also in the works. Follow our Instagram (@uoliv_cubing) or join the WhatsApp group chat for more regular updates on upcoming events, hope to see you there!

short_description: Passionate about disability awareness? Want to feel part of an inclusive community? Then join Disability Society!
long_description: Passionate about disability awareness? Want to feel part of an inclusive community? Then join Disability Society! Disability Society wishes to raise awareness and create an inclusive community at University of Liverpool where students who face barriers due to a variety of long term illnesses and conditions can meet, socialise and promote accessibility in academia. We also welcome students who do not identify as disabled but have an interest in disability activism and support. We define disability broadly to include physical, sensory and invisible impairments, chronic illness, mental health conditions, dyslexia, dyspraxia and neuro-diverse conditions. There is no such thing as "not disabled enough"!

short_description: The Disabled Students Community is for any student who has any disability or self-identifies as a disabled person or a person with a disability.
Diversity in Law Society empowers students passionate about equality and representation in the legal profession through inspiring speakers, career workshops, networking events and inclusive socials.
long_description: The legal profession shapes society, but it doesn’t yet fully reflect it. Diversity in Law Society exists to change that. We are a supportive and ambitious community for students who care about representation, accessibility and inclusion within the legal sector. Whether you want to become a solicitor, barrister, or simply learn more about the profession, this society is here to help you feel confident, connected and inspired. We believe that talent exists everywhere, but opportunity does not, and university is the perfect place to start closing that gap. Diversity in Law is for everyone. Whether you are from an underrepresented background or passionate about becoming an ally, you’ll find a space here to grow, learn and belong. Join us as we work towards a legal profession that truly reflects the society it serves.

short_description: Dover Court Halls’ Student Committee (HSC) is a committee of students living in Dover, who will organise events and activities to make your time in Liverpool the best it can be!
long_description: You can get involved in your HSC by signing up on this page and emailing hsc@liverpool.ac.uk to let us know! Look out for your HSC's welcome meeting, which will take place on in the first week of term! HSC Training will take place on Wednesday 1st October - tickets will be listed here once they are available! Any questions? Email hsc@liverpool.ac.uk where the HSC team will get back to you as soon as possible!

short_description: Economics society is an ambitious society that encourages all those taking Economics/Business Economic based degrees to get to know each other and socialise.
long_description: Economics society is an ambitious society that encourages all those taking Economics/Business Economic based degrees to get to know each other and socialise. It allows a mixture of year groups to integrate and support one another through several socials throughout the year. It gives students an opportunity to expand their economic knowledge in a more relaxed, friendly environment.

short_description: Environmental Science Society is for anyone and everyone.
long_description: Environmental Science Society is for anyone and everyone. From people who do not know where to start with making environmental changes to those already interested and on the road to sustainability. We plan to focus on a range of environmental issues, from plastic littering to biodiversity and climate change. This society is a place for environmental science students of all years to meet other people doing the same subject, or people from any background who wish to be involved.

short_description: The Liverpool European Affairs Society is one of the newest members of the European Affairs Society Network, which aims to develop relationships between university students in the UK and the EU.
Mabuhay! Welcome to the University of Liverpool's Filipino Society!
long_description: Mabuhay! Welcome to the University of Liverpool's Filipino Society! Established in 2021. We aim to create a community for all university students in Liverpool (both Filipino and non-Filipino) and create a 'Home away from home'. We plan to create events engaging in Filipino culture, offering a variety of activities, socials and food! So join our society to be a part of our Pamilya - We can't wait to meet you all

short_description: At the UoL Film Society we welcome everyone with a passion for cinema.
long_description: The UoL Film Society is a place for those who love cinema. We host three film screenings every week (Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays) as well as other activities like quizzes, society collabs and pub crawls. We show a wide variety of films, so there'll always be something for everyone. If you prefer niche, artsy films, then come to our Friday showings where Chairman Dan has organised an array of old classics and hidden gems! Follow our Instagram (@uolfilm) and sign up for a membership to keep up to date with all of our events! Committee 2025/26 President - Joseph Higgitt Vice President - Luca Isaac-Harris Secretary - Conor O'Sullivan Treasurer - Noa Thaw Event Secretary - Ciara Tracey Media Secretary - Joe Pattrick Honorary Chairman - Dan Horton

Hi everyone, salut à toutes et à tous! This is the University of Liverpool’s official French Society. The French Society is a place to connect with French or francophone students, improve your french and expand your interest, knowledge and cultural awareness regarding France or other francophone countries. Whether you're French, have French family roots or relations, or simply like all things french, this is the society for you! Tout le mode est bienvenu :) The aim is to create a community revolving around French language and culture, whilst offering a variety of activities, socials and food! As well as conversation groups to help develop fluency in French, through experiences for everyone to enjoy. If this sounds like the society for you, sign up! Follow us on our instagram or join the WhatsApp community to stay updated on what's going on!

short_description: Hey! Welcome to the University of Liverpool's Gaming Society.
long_description: Hey! Welcome to the University of Liverpool's Gaming Society. We offer a space for both causal and Esports gaming. We welcome all skill levels from beginner to pro! We'll be hosting weekly meetups and mini competitions where you can chat and play against each other. Looking for something a bit more competitive? We also have various e-sports teams to join! Our discord is where most of our announcements are made and is also a great place to talk to talk to or play online with other members! Join the discord here: https://discord.gg/3zxSyeAC5j Our instagram is uolgamingsociety!

short_description: University of Liverpool Geography Society is here for all students of Geography.
long_description: University of Liverpool Geography Society is here for all students of Geography. We organise events and activities throughout the year for everyone to socialise and help with their studies; from bar crawls, to quizzes, a Christmas and Summer Ball and revision sessions, there is something for all Geographers to get stuck in this year at Liverpool!

short_description: Creating a network for medical students on the programme and creating a space for students interested in the Graduate Entry Programme.
long_description: Who are we? We're Graduate Entry Medicine (GEM) AKA Graduate Entry Programme (GEP) society. We plan to create a network for prospective and current medical students on the course, as well as a space for medical students to connect with each other. AIMS: We want to promote GEM to students and anyone interested in an alternative route to medicine Planning socials during the academic year Delivering teaching sessions Promoting the course and connecting students together

We are enthusiastic about the German culture and language. As part of this society, you can join German themed events, such as pub trips, film viewings, and board games. Follow us on instagram or join our whatsapp group (link through our instagram page) for information about our upcoming events.

short_description: Welcome to University of Liverpool Gig Society!
long_description: UoL gig society is a place for those who love live music or would like to find out more about live music! We host socials every other week and attend gigs and festivals all across the North West and beyond. Join gig soc to meet a group of great people and discover your next favourite band! Instagram: @uolgigsoc Email: gig@society.liverpoolguild.org

Girls in Tech is the University of Liverpool’s premier society dedicated to rebranding the tech industry through our "Pink with a Purpose" philosophy, which blends high-end aesthetics with serious professional value. We provide immense value by creating a safe space sisterhood where female students can transition from tech beginners to career-ready professionals through our fortnightly events, which offer fun, girly experiences with a technical twist, as well as industry networking and CV-boosting projects. By proving that femininity and creativity are assets, not barriers, in Tech, we are actively dismantling stereotypes and building a vital talent pipeline for Liverpool’s growing digital economy.

short_description: Global Opportunities Society is a place to meet people from around the world- those who came here for their study exchange, those who consider one, just came back or who just want to travel!
long_description: Global Opportunities Society is a society that welcomes everyone. Those who are studying here at Liverpool on their mobility, those who have been or are preparing for their mobility and those who want to know more about where they could go and learn what amazing experiences are on offer through fun socials and culture nights!

short_description: Representing the Green Party of England and Wales on campus. Let's make hope normal again!
long_description: We are the Young Green's University of Liverpool Society, affiliated with the Youth branch of the Green Party of England and Wales. Whether you’re a member, supporter, or someone who’s never been involved with politics, join to meet like-minded people and hang out. We have regular meet-ups to do all kinds of things, political and not. Follow us on Instagram (@livuniyounggreens) for any updates! Our committee for the 2026/2027 Academic Year: President - Faysal Ahmed Secretary - Kyran Wise Treasurer - Lila Sturdy

guild_name: Greenbank Student Village Halls' Student Committee
short_description: Greenbank Halls’ Student Committee (HSC) is a committee of students living in Greenbank, who will organise events and activities to make your time in Liverpool the best it can be!
long_description: You can get involved in your HSC by signing up on this page and emailing hsc@liverpool.ac.uk to let us know! Look out for your HSC's welcome meeting, which will take place on in the first week of term! HSC Training will take place on Wednesday 1st October - tickets will be listed here once they are available! Any questions? Email hsc@liverpool.ac.uk where the HSC team will get back to you as soon as possible!

short_description: Treat people with kindness.. and join the harry styles society 🍉
A society for history students and history lovers alike to come together and share their appreciation for this vast and unending subject.
long_description: A society for history students and history lovers alike to come together and share their appreciation for this vast and unending subject. Come and join us for study sessions, pub crawls, and exciting events throughout the year and across the University!

Embarking on Your University Journey? Join Our Vibrant Community! Are you an international student from Hong Kong starting at the University this year? Let us be your guide and supportive friends as you navigate this exciting new chapter. We are a diverse group of second-year students from different subjects and faculties united by our shared Hong Kong roots. Our mission is to create a welcoming space where you can immerse yourself in university life while celebrating your unique cultural identity. Say goodbye to feeling lost or overwhelmed – we've got your back, every step of the way!

short_description: Hi! We are Hong Kong Student Live (HKSL), a group of Christian students from Hong Kong aiming to offer help and support to international students who are new to Liverpool.
long_description: Hi! We are Hong Kong Student Live (HKSL), a group of Christian students from Hong Kong aiming to offer help and support to international students who are new to Liverpool. Throughout the year, we will meet regularly in order to catch up with each other; as well as have discussions regarding Hong Kong and its current climate, with the intent of focusing on the thoughts and ideas behind the younger generation of Hong Kong. We also plan to schedule events that provide opportunities for newcomers to explore and discover Christianity with us, through a variety of means such as group conversations, games or even a retreat.

short_description: The International Students Community exists for International students to come together, socialise, make friends and bring positive change to students University experiences. This includes students...
long_description: The International Students Network exists for International students to come together, socialise, make friends and bring positive change to students University experiences. This includes students from both within and, outside the European Union (EU) and those who pay both home and international fees.

short_description: The Irish society aims to bring together Irish and Northern Irish students.
long_description: The Irish society aims to bring together Irish and Northern Irish students. Whether you're Irish, have Irish family roots, or simply love all things Irish, our society is the perfect fit for you! Looking for a fun way to meet new people and have a bit of craic. We hold regular nights out, sports viewings, and a weekly Pop-Up Gaeltacht.

short_description: Ciao! The Italian Society is a place to meet Italian students, improve your Italian and expand your interest and culture awareness regarding Italy.
long_description: Ciao! The Italian Society is a place to meet Italian students, improve your Italian and expand your interest and culture awareness regarding Italy. It is a welcoming space open to everyone, no matter where you come from. We will run online events, such as quizzes and film nights, but also conversation groups to support students that want to develop fluency skills.

short_description: The Japan Society is a welcoming community for anyone interested in Japanese culture, language, and society!
long_description: In Japanese Culture Society, we want many people to experience and learn Japanese culture through activities and events! We would love to welcome all of you who would like to know Japanese culture, learn Japanese language, experience Japanese events and foods! Also, if you are from Japan, it is a good chance to meet other Japanese students too!

short_description: Aiming to find the best kebab shop in Liverpool.
The Korean society is a society created for all students in University of Liverpool who are interested in Korea.
long_description: The Korean society is a society created for all students in University of Liverpool who are interested in Korea. For this community, we want to deliver Korean culture and languages spread around the world more comfortably to those who are in Liverpool. In particular, Korean students who are in the university can meet and socialize with each other. Therefore, we always welcome those who are interested in Korean language, Korean culture, Korean music, Korean food, etc.

short_description: Are you a fan of Kpop? Or have you by chance, come across a song, a music video, a post on Instagram or a mere tweet that piqued your interest in Kpop?
long_description: Are you a fan of Kpop? Or have you by chance, come across a song, a music video, a post on Instagram or a mere tweet that piqued your interest in Kpop? If your answer is yes to either of these questions, then Kpop Society is definitely the one-stop society for you! Here at University of Liverpool Kpop Society, we welcome anyone regardless of their background, and whether you have only just discovered Kpop or if you have been a fan for several years! We aim to create an all-inclusive space where fans can come together to share our love for the ever-rising Hallyu wave.

short_description: Socialist Labour Students Club. Socials, Socialism, Strikes and Solidarity!
long_description: Socialism, Strikes, Solidarity, and Socials! What is Labour Students? Labour Students is a left-wing socialist activist group on campus. Make sure to follow us on our social media for more info and updates about our next event. UPCOMING EVENTS: AGM Wednesday 3rd June, on Zoom Our committee for 2025/26 academic year: Co-Chairs: Krish Daryanani and Emily Belt Secretary: Isaac Sykes Treasurer: Matthew Elam Social Secretary: Jamie Magill Womens Officer: Erin Cullen BAME Officer: Maya Desai Disabilities Officer: Jamie Newton TULO: Oliver Hughes LGBTQ Officer: Mason Day

Bienvenidos/Bem-vindos/Welcome to the Latin American Society! We’re a warm and vibrant community that embodies the heart of Latin culture – open arms and a welcoming spirit! Whether you’re Latina(o) or simply in love with the richness of our music, food, dance, and traditions, this is your space. It’s more than just a society; it’s a little piece of home where we come together to celebrate our culture, share unforgettable moments, and ease the homesickness with a sense of belonging. Here, you’ll make meaningful friendships, connect with amazing people, and experience the joy and warmth that make us Latinos so special. Everyone is welcome, and we can’t wait to meet you. Let’s make your university journey unforgettable – come join us! ❤️🌎

short_description: We welcome all members of the LGBT+ community and allies to all our events!
long_description: We welcome all members of the LGBT+ community and allies to all our events! The LGBT+ society at the University of Liverpool aims to brings its members together in a safe and fun social environment, and campaign for change and progress for LGBT+ rights in society. Our events are for LGBT+ people and allies, and whether you are wanting to join us to have a good time at university, or there’s a cause you want to raise awareness for, the society is here to support you to do that.

short_description: The LGBTQ+ Community includes all students that self-identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual and trans, and the plus sign exists to include other identities.
Liv Yoga is your UoL Yoga Society.
long_description: Liv Yoga is your UoL Yoga Society. Yoga is the perfect addition to Uni Life as it combines physical and mental wellbeing, keeping you healthy and relaxed between studying and socialising. Practising can help with anxiety, stress and down days as well as strength, flexibility and agility. We’re open to EVERYONE, whether you’ve never stepped on the mat before or you’re practically a Pro. Our classes are led by a wonderful hand-picked group of professional teachers from around Liverpool who will guide you through a range of Yoga styles to see what works for you. As well as classes, you can expect some super fun Socials with a lovely bunch of people.

guild_name: Liverpool Chinese Students and Scholars Association (LCSSA)
short_description: LCSSA is the most influential student organisation among Chinese student groups in the Liverpool area and the largest local Chinese students and scholars association.
long_description: LCSSA is the most influential student organisation among Chinese student groups in the Liverpool area and the largest local Chinese students and scholars association. The main members of the Liverpool student union are Chinese students and scholars, and scholars who have worked in the UK after studying abroad. Every year, LCSSA organises various extracurricular activities and events for students to participate in, including academic lectures, sports competitions and cultural activities and evening parties.

short_description: We are Liverpool Debating Union, the official debating society for all of the universities in Liverpool.
long_description: We are Liverpool Debating Union, the official debating society for all of the universities in Liverpool. Everyone is welcome in our society, no matter your age or experience level - we promise that there's a friendly, inclusive atmosphere! We also hold public debates, a variety of socials and opportunities to attend competitions across the UK and Europe.

short_description: The Liverpool Engineers Society is the largest academic society at the University of Liverpool. We are a student-led society that aims to enhance your time studying Engineering at Liverpool.
long_description: We aim to further your university experience both socially and academically. We hold frequent social and networking events, winter and summer formals, trips and promote graduate and placement opportunities to give our members the best chance at securing and succeeding at their dream jobs. We cover Aerospace, Architectural, Avionics, Civil, Electrical, Mechanical disciplines and Industrial design. Whether you are studying these degrees or just have an interest in this industry, follow us on our social media to keep up to date... Sports Teams We have a Football, Rugby and Netball team open to all abilities and are there for a good time! Holding weekly training, games and socials, it is a great way to make new friends on your course and with others. Engineering Football Engineering Rugby Engineering Netball Committee: President - Neha Fleet & Harriette Tooth Vice – Presidents: Hannah Colborn & Keshika Vasuja Secretary: Dihan Akter Treasurer: Kornel Milewski Social Secretaries: Evie Purdam & Amelie Duncalf Social Media Secretaries: Elisha Harrison Welfare Officer: Hnin Lwin

short_description: Liverpool ENT Society is for anyone who is interested in surgery or ENT as a career or is looking to explore new specialties.

guild_name: Liverpool Fetal Medicine and Surgery Society (LFMSS)
short_description: Liverpool Fetal Medicine and Surgery Society (LFMSS) aims to bring interested medical students into contact with the new, exciting fields of fetal medicine and surgery.
long_description: Liverpool Fetal Medicine and Surgery Society (LFMSS) aims to bring interested medical students into contact with the new, exciting fields of fetal medicine and surgery. We aim to inform students on cutting edge fetal interventions involving through a combination of teaching sessions, networking opportunities and research updates. We want to put students in touch with this rapidly evolving field, allowing them to learn more about a profession that is at the forefront of medical innovation. If you are interested in a career where you can change lives before they even begin, LFMSS is the place to start!

Welcome to Liv GP Society! The GP Society is a student-led community dedicated to promoting interest in general practice and primary care. We aim to provide students with insight into the role of a GP through engaging talks, practical workshops, and opportunities to connect with others Everyone is welcome - stay tuned for further details of events! ...Not every medical mystery needs a hospital drama - sometimes it just needs a good GP.

short_description: Welcome to Liverpool Guild Student Media, a place where you can get involved in Radio, TV, or Publishing!
long_description: Welcome to Liverpool Guild Student Media, a place where you can get involved in Radio, TV, or Publishing! See where your work could be showcased on our website.

short_description: Welcome and namaste to all, we are a society that embraces anyone who is interested in celebrating and learning about Hinduism.
long_description: Welcome and namaste to all, we are a society that embraces anyone who is interested in celebrating and learning about Hinduism. NHSF Liverpool is connected to a national body of Hindus and students, working to create a safer space to practice and promote Hindu Dharma (way of living/duty). Since we are part of a national society, you will have the opportunity to travel to other universities and participate in their social events, national sports/dance competitions and get involved with volunteering work around the country. As a society, we want to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our members and you don’t have to be Hindu to join!

short_description: The Law Society aims to kickstart your legal career by providing a mix of academic, employability, and social events throughout the year.
long_description: The Law Society aims to kickstart your legal career by providing a mix of academic, employability, and social events throughout the year. With more than 600 members, the Law Society is both the largest law society and biggest academic society on campus. We welcome both law and non-law students who have an interest in pursuing a career in the legal world. As a law society, we cherish diversity and inclusion. We are proud of the progress we have already made, such as fundraising for charities and coordinating BAME workshops, but diversity and inclusion is always going to be a journey and there will always be scope to get better. A legal career is notoriously competitive; therefore, our academic events aim to provide our members the opportunity to gain numerous transferrable skills and enhance their CV.

short_description: Come, be a part of the Malayalee Society, where culture thrives, friendships flourish, and the spirit of Kerala comes to life in Liverpool!
long_description: Welcome to the Malayalee Society, your vibrant gateway to the heart of Malayalee culture right here in Liverpool! We warmly invite everyone to gather together and celebrate the rich Malayalee heritage, music, cinema, dance, cuisine, and so much more. Our society hopes to offer a space for Mallus from all across Liverpool, both current and future members to unite and support one another, enriching our university journey with the flavours of our culture. Join us on an incredible journey as we hope to organise a diverse range of events that honour our Malyalalee roots, and create new friendships and unforgettable memories! Get ready for an exciting lineup of events! We’re planning meet and greets, movie nights, game nights, sports socials and thrilling night outs. We're excited to make sure there's something for everyone and can't wait to hear your ideas too! Come, be a part of the Malayalee Society, where culture thrives, friendships flourish, and the spirit of Kerala comes to life in Liverpool!

short_description: Welcome to Liverpool Marrow! We are the student branch of Anthony Nolan charity. Volunteer with us and help save lives through stem cells!
long_description: Patients with blood cancers and blood disorders may eventually need a stem cell transplant in order to save their lives. Often a match can be found from the patient's family, however 75% of patients turn to the national stem cell register to find their donor. Anthony Nolan works to sign up potential life savers to the stem cell register and locates matches for patients in desperate need every day. Last year, Anthony Nolan helped 1,300 individuals to find their life-saving match. Come help us complete our pledge of signing up 200 potential lifesavers this year ! Get involved with our donor recruitment events throughout the year. Help us raise money for Anthony Nolan - it costs around £40 to add someone to the register. Diversify the register with us. There is a vital need as caucasian patients are 70% likely to find a match however people from BAME backgrounds are only around 20% likely to find their potential lifesaver !

short_description: Step into the shoes of world leaders, debate global issues, and sharpen your diplomacy skills with UOL Model United Nations!
We welcome all fellow trainee occupational therapists and anyone interested in the nature of occupational therapy within the health care setting.
long_description: We welcome all fellow trainee occupational therapists and anyone interested in the nature of occupational therapy within the health care setting. We link with other healthcare related societies to network between professions. We celebrate our course through annual events so that all students have time to network as well as enjoy themselves separate to such an intense academic course. Whether you want to connect socially with other occupational therapists, get involved in raising money for different charities or get together for educational opportunities, gatherings or speeches connected to the practice of occupational therapy, join the society for free and join our community!

short_description: Liverpool Sikh Medical Society is a friendly community bringing Sikh values, culture, and medicine together.
Welcome to Liverpool Sikh Society!
long_description: Welcome to Liverpool Sikh Society! We are open to all students studying at Liverpool Universities. Our mission is to provide a 'home away from home' environment where students can meet new people and engage with Sikhi. Over the years we have arranged a number of Sikh related events including: Kirtan on Campus, Langar on Campus, Basics of Sikhi talks and Gurdwara visits to name a few. Whilst maintaining a Sikh ethos, we also arrange a number of charitable and social events throughout the year. This is a great way to meet others and take a break from your studies. Don't forget to become a member of the society. We look forward to meeting you soon!

short_description: LUDS (University of Liverpool's Drama Society) involves everything related to theatre - and more!
long_description: Welcome to LUDS! (University of Liverpool’s Drama Society). We offer members the chance to act, direct, write, design sets and costumes, do backstage and tech, perform stand up, sketch comedy, and almost anything else you can think of related to theatre! We put on several plays a semester, and have frequent socials, writing opportunities, workshops, and other stuff you can get involved in, so check out our Instagram page to see what we’ve got going on in the next few weeks! If comedy is what you're interested in then follow our sketch comedy group who perform several times in Liverpool and go to Edinburgh Fringe Festival every year, @theliverpoolrevue, and if writing theatre, poetry, spoken-word, etc. is more your thing then follow @ludswrite and start writing -- as every year we also take a piece of new writing or two, usually one-act plays, up to Edinburgh Fringe.

short_description: LUST is the University's musical theatre society. We usually put on 4 student-led shows a year, performed in the Stanley Theatre.
long_description: We provide an opportunity for people to not only be part of a cast and perform, but to also produce shows, perform in bands, help backstage and become part of a loving community. We also do various socials and formals throughout the year where people can build friendships that last a lifetime!

short_description: Ever wondered what to do if you were the first person at an RTA? Or if a call is put out for a medic on a plane? Could you help a stabbing victim with what you've got in front of you?
long_description: Ever wondered what to do if you were the first person at an RTA? Or if a call is put out for a medic on a plane? Could you help a stabbing victim with what you’ve got in front of you? Come join us for hands-on teaching sessions every Thursday, where you’ll learn the A-E’s and beyond of managing medical emergencies, even before your clinical years! Through simulated patient scenarios, learn how to identify and manage extreme environments from blistering heat and bitter cold, to altitude and dive medicine, trauma care, and major incident management (Just to name a few!) But don’t worry, we’re also a very social society! We catch up at the pub after sessions and host bar crawls, pub quizzes and other events. Drinkers and non drinkers are welcome!

short_description: This society is focused on spreading awareness for countries in need by engaging students in quizzes, enjoyable events, lectures and even fundraising for particular countries in need.
LivPalestine is a student-solidarity group that welcomes Palestinians and anyone in Liverpool who is interested in Palestinian culture, history, or politics.
long_description: LivPalestine is a student-solidarity group that welcomes anyone in Liverpool who is interested in Palestinian culture, history, or politics. We strive to provide a safe educational and sociable network for students, collectively advocating toward justice for Palestine.

short_description: We are a society dedicated to providing an enriching musical experience for our large group of students from across the university.
long_description: We are a society dedicated to providing an enriching musical experience for our large group of students from across the university. Whatever your preference of music, we have an ensemble for you! Our society has 9 ensembles including Stage and Screen Orchestra, All Voices Choir, Big Band and more (and you can join as many as you wish). These ensembles encompass many styles of music including, but not limited to, classical, jazz, pop and film music. Most of these ensembles are run by fellow hard-working students determined to provide you with the most enriching experience possible. At the end of each semester we have a collective concert to celebrate all of our hard work and dedication throughout all of our ensemble rehearsals. Every ensemble will be able to perform for the rest of the society as well as friends and family in this amazing setting.

short_description: NEW COMMITTEE 25/26 MathSoc is a society for those with an interest in all things Maths!
long_description: MathSoc is a society for those with an interest in all things Maths! Whether you're a math enthusiast or just curious about the subject, we offer a diverse and welcoming environment to learn, solve puzzles, and connect with like-minded individuals. From engaging discussions and thought-provoking challenges to game nights and math-themed socials, there's something for everyone. We are open to everyone from all backgrounds - not just Maths students - so feel free to join us. Our aim is to create an safe and fun environment for people with a common interest in Maths - whether it be making new friends or accessing Maths-related support from peers. Come along to meet like minded people either with some friends or solo. All years of study are welcome! President - Malaika Iqbal Secretary - Evie Thorp Treasurer - Yousaf Majid Social Sec - Josie Dodd 2nd Year Rep - Ann Fernandes Post-grad Rep - Kayleigh Halpin General Committee - Aaliyah Chowdhury, Ethan Scott, Asa Ryan This year we're also introducing UoL campus league sports teams! Netball organised by Evie Allen Football organised by Oscar Hodgkinson and Joe Baxter If you have any questions feel free to email us or DM us on our instagram account LIVMATHSOC !!!!

long_description: The Mature Students Network exists for mature students to come together, socialise, make friends and bring positive change to students University experiences. Mature students include all students who are ages 21 or over at the start of their studies and mature postgraduate students are ages 26 and over.

short_description: Find your community - join the Mature Students Society
long_description: The Mature Students Society is here to support and connect students. Whether you're balancing studies with family, work, or just looking to meet like-minded people, this is a space for you. Mature students are typically undergraduates aged 21+ and postgraduates aged 25+. However, we welcome members of any age. Join us for: social events study groups workshops networking on campus meet-ups supportive community This society aims to support, inform and involve every single mature student at the University. We can't do this without our members so join today and look out for our upcoming events!

short_description: NeuroSoc is a medical society for anyone interested in neurosciences - this includes research in neurosciences, as well as clinical neurology and neurosurgery!
long_description: Throughout the year, we host large events such as our annual Conference and surgical skills workshops. However, we will also host neurology teaching delivered by older medical students, registrars and consultants throughout the year for anyone finding these topics difficult, just in need of a revision session :) We will also be hosting some fun, general activity nights throughout the year that are not Neuro-themed, so feel free to join and come along!

The North African Society is a welcoming space that focuses on celebrating and sharing the cultures of North Africa, including Arab and Amazigh heritage. We highlight the region’s rich history, traditions, languages, and modern identity. Whether you have North African roots or are simply curious, our society offers a friendly community where culture is shared, stories are exchanged, and understanding is built.

short_description: This society hopes to be a welcoming space where Pakistani students studying at the University of Liverpool can get to know each other.
long_description: This society hopes to be a welcoming space where Pakistani students studying at the University of Liverpool can get to know each other. To do this, we will run events and socials where everyone can come together and celebrate Pakistani culture, both raising awareness for issues and raising money for charities trying to tackle them. We envision this society playing an active role in student life and to be a first port-of-call to any problems that anyone has.

short_description: Welcome to the official University of Liverpool Physics Society.
long_description: Welcome to the official University of Liverpool Physics Society. We are an academic society for anyone with a love for Physics, whether you study it or simply have an interest in it. Throughout the year we will hold a variety of events, academic and social. Our aim is to hold events such as academic talks with physics field specialists, physics help sessions, and social events.

short_description: The Physiotherapy Society is open to all students studying Physiotherapy BSc and Msc it is an integral part of the social and academic life for physiotherapy students.
long_description: The Physiotherapy Society is open to all students studying Physiotherapy BSc and Msc it is an integral part of the social and academic life for physiotherapy students. It is a great opportunity to meet other students on the course, particularly in other years, get involved in CPD activities and networking through the profession.

short_description: Welcome to the University of Liverpool Planning Society!
long_description: Welcome to the University of Liverpool Planning Society! Planning Society is an academic community where Planning students and people with an interest in town planning can come together. Through a series of informal events over the year, as a member of Planning Society you'll have plenty of opportunities to meet fellow planning students and take part in career development and networking opportunities. As well as holding regular social events, Planning Society is the best way to keep informed about planning news, job opportunities and general advice. As a student-led group, Planning Society is a course-wide support network for students to approach for guidance during their time at university. Be sure to follow our Instagram @livuniplanning_society to stay updated!

short_description: Poker Society is a place for all levels of players looking to both learn how to play or push themselves and develop their skills
long_description: Poker Society is a place for all levels of players looking to both learn how to play or push themselves and develop their skills, we host a range of weekly tournaments and a great social space to meet new people.

short_description: Welcome to Pole and Aerial Dance Society! We offer weekly classes to build skill, strength, confidence and friendships whilst learning Pole, Aerial Hoop and Flexibility!
long_description: Welcome to Pole and Aerial Dance Society! We offer weekly classes to build skill, strength, confidence and friendships whilst learning Pole, Aerial Hoop and Flexibility.You do not have to have any experience, strength, flexibility or a certain body type - we are for everyone. Our instructors are super friendly, supportive and talented so don’t miss the chance to make the most of this opportunity!We also do weekly socials, so keep an eye out on our insta and WhatsApp for details - we can't wait to meet you! <3Classes are coming soon and tickets will be available to purchase from this webpage! Keep an eye on the socials for updates xx

short_description: Liverpool Politics Society is a place for students with all levels of political knowledge and different views who seek to learn more and engage in stimulating debate as well as to make friends.
long_description: We are Liverpool's Politics Society, a group of students with all levels of political knowledge that seek to challenge ourselves, engage in stimulating debate, and educate ourselves regarding international affairs, political ideologies, and topical issues here in the UK. We hope to change the perception of politics as an exclusive, intimidating space by encouraging accessibility and inclusivity in our discussions, debates, and socials! We host a series of events throughout the year from socials, networking events, outreach programmes and Balls! Everyone, of all ideological positioning and political knowledge, is welcome, as we promise to provide you with a healthy, open, and friendly environment for you to explore your own views, and the views of those around you!

long_description: EVENTS About us The Psychology Society (PsycSoc) is student-led and aims to enhance both the social and academic aspects of University life. We are here to ensure you all have an enjoyable, memorable and dynamic university experience. All PsycSoc members will have the opportunity to take part in various exciting socials throughout the year. Our events are not only super fun, but provide the opportunity to make new friendships and connections outside of lecture halls. We also work closely with other societies to deliver joint events, giving students the opportunity to make diverse friendships outside of the psychology degree bubble. Follow us on our Socials! short_description: QueerMedics is a society for LGBT+ medics and allies who want a better future for LGBT+ patients.
long_description: QueerMedics is a society for LGBT+ medics and allies who want a better future for LGBT+ patients. We want you to have a safe space to develop yourself as a professional as you learn about how to better cater to patients of different gender identities or sexualities. We will provide you with teaching sessions and resources to learn more about LGBT+ healthcare and answer your questions. We also want to have fun and meet other LGBT+ students, so look forward to socials and having a good time!

short_description: Welcome to the official Racing Society for Liverpool - If it's to do with racing, we're here for it! This is the home for motorsport fans, karting hobbyists and adrenaline junkies alike!!
long_description: Welcome to the official Racing Society for Liverpool - If it's to do with racing, we're here for it! No matter your background or level of experience/knowledge around racing and the motorsport world we're the place for you to feed your adrenaline adiction. From us you can expect live watchalong parties for motorsport events, monthly karting meetings, Sim racing experiences, exciting nights out, team racing championships and a host of racing related content! Every year as a society we have grown into a stronger and more fulfilling group for our members, there has never been a better time to join up and be part of the racing family in Liverpool <3 The heart of society communications can be found @uolracingsociety on Instagram - if you have any question, recomendations, or messages for us don't be shy to get in touch! We're also the home of Liverpool's BUKC team who compete at a national level against other universities around the UK (Contact Our Team Captain for more info).

short_description: The REACH Students' Community is a space for REACH students to socialise, share experiences and discuss issues with likeminded people.
The aim of the society will be to go to different restaurants to explore and try different cuisines and consequently learn about different cultures and history through this.
Here at Rock Society, we like music LOUD! Rock Soc aims to unite students who share a passion for rock and metal music.
long_description: Here at Rock Society, we like music quiet! Rock Soc aims to unite students who share a passion for rock and metal music. From punk to goth, extreme metal to classic rock and everything in between, Rock Soc is the HQ for all Rock, Punk, Alt & Metal Fans on campus. This is the place to find others for gigging, festivals, and of course the banter of all things rock and metal. We want to show those who are new to the city their way around Liverpool's epic rock and metal scene.

short_description: Welcome to the University of Liverpool Salsa Society!
long_description: Welcome to the University of Liverpool Salsa Society! We specialise in teaching Cuban Salsa and Bachata. If you want to learn a new skill, boost your confidence or meet new people, all whilst having fun, this society is for you. We are a diverse, friendly and welcoming society and we have classes for beginner and intermediate levels. Dancing is a great way to keep fit, release endorphins and express yourself, which makes it a fun way deal with university life. What is unique about our society is that there is a huge international scene in Liverpool and more. There are salsa socials outside of our society and clubs that have nights dedicated to the love of this dance, including Revolution de Cuba. There are also festivals and events all over the city. If you get involved in this community the possibilities of meeting new people are endless.

short_description: Science Fiction Society is a social and workshop space for creatives and fans who want to share their love for SF!
long_description: Movies, games, books—anything goes! Join our events and meet a community of people who share a passion for the SF genre!We plan to host a myriad of events including presentation nights, craft nights, media discussions, and more!Even if you're unfamiliar with the genre, we invite you to come along and meet new people! Science Fiction has a massive overlap with almost everything, so you're bound to find something you like.Check out our website for more info: tinyurl.com/sfsocfollow our Instagram: @uol.sf Contact us at sciencefiction@society.liverpoolguild.orgOur Discord server! https://discord.gg/BZxgVrxD8QAnd our Whatsapp channels, where we post most of our announcements and chat casually! We hope to see you there ;)

Whether you're looking to make friends, enhance your academic experience, or explore future career paths, there is something for everyone to get involved in and have a great time! 2025/26 Committee: President - Amelia Aubrey-Rees Vice-President - Heidi Pagan Secretary - Amy Harris Treasurer - Annabel Van Den Burg Social Secretaries - Darcy Cargill & Scarlet Papanicolaou

short_description: The Solicitors Society is committed to facilitating your journey from student to solicitor.
long_description: The Solicitors Society is committed to facilitating your journey from student to solicitor. We organise a series of in-person and virtual events throughout the year to provide you with the skillset and practical experience you need to succeed in applications for legal roles, vacation schemes, and open days. We share deadlines and other details across our social media platforms, keeping you informed, and we are happy to help with any applications you need help with. We organise brilliant social events, designed to suit everyone, and to allow you to make friends and build your personal network of legal contacts. Everyone is welcome in the Solicitors Society, we endeavour to make everyone feel welcome, and we are here to talk to you about law and everything else, don't be afraid to reach out! To the non-law students out there, do not be intimidated, law firms love non-law students and we are here to support you just as much as law students.

We are the Liverpool Universities Scouts and Guides (LUSSAGO)! Whether you're a lifelong Scouting or Guiding member, or are just thinking of joining, we'd love to meet and see you at our meetings!
long_description: We are the Liverpool Universities Scouts and Guides (LUSSAGO)! Whether you're a lifelong Scouting or Guiding member, or are just thinking of joining, we'd love to meet and see you at our meetings! We welcome members from all Liverpool universities. We normally meet at 8pm at the Guild on thursdays in term time. Keep an eye on our instagram because sometimes we go out and about! We also run camping trips a few times a year, so even if you can't meet on a Thursday it's still worth joining! Contact us: Instagram - @livuniscoutsandguides Email - scoutsandguides@society.liverpoolguild.org

short_description: Teddy Bear Hospital is an organisation that teaches school children about health and well being, as well as encouraging them to interact with medical professionals so that they are more likely to...
long_description: Teddy Bear Hospital is an organisation that teaches school children about health and well being, as well as encouraging them to interact with medical professionals so that they are more likely to have a positive experience if they need medical attention. The children bring their teddies along with them to the sessions, which are held in schools and extra-curricular groups such as Rainbows and Cubs, and the teddy bear doctors (our volunteers) treat their teddies, as well as teaching them about things like healthy eating, the body, and hand washing.

short_description: The 93% Club is a student-led society dedicated to improving the experiences of state-educated students at the University of Liverpool.
long_description: The 93% Club is a student-led society dedicated to improving the experiences of state-educated students at the University of Liverpool. We are the 93% of students that went to state schools in the UK, and we are dedicated to promoting access and opportunity for socio-economically and educationally disadvantaged students at the University of Liverpool.

long_description: A passionate group of TCG gamers! we love playing card games, and want to create a fun environment for old and new people alike to get to know different games and have fun! short_description: Come and join University of Liverpool's biggest dance society. We offer weekly classes in a variety of different dance styles which cater for all abilities, including: Ballet, Tap, Jazz and more
long_description: Come and join University of Liverpool's biggest dance society. We offer weekly classes in a variety of different dance styles which cater for all abilities, including: Ballet, Tap, Jazz, Commercial Street, Contemporary and Heels. These classes are held by our external teachers who are professionally trained and graduated from some of the best dance schools in the UK including the Royal Ballet School and LIPA. We are very excited to be back dancing with everyone, look out for the times of our taster and our weekly timetable coming soon on our Instagram!

guild_name: University of Liverpool Islamic Society - uolivisoc
short_description: We are a society dedicated to providing an Islamic community and presence for students of the University of Liverpool. Through a range of enriching socials, talks, and other events- we create a f...
long_description: We are a society dedicated to providing an Islamic community and presence for students of the University of Liverpool. Through a range of enriching socials, talks, and other events- we create a family-like atmosphere. The society is diverse and welcomes everyone from undergraduates to postgraduates and alumni of the university; Muslims and non-Muslims; as well as all backgrounds and ethnicities.

short_description: Welcome to Photo society! Contrary to popular belief, photography is an art accessible to anyone and everyone. You only need your artistic vision and passion to get started. Please join us!
long_description: As a society, we want to give you a space to improve and develop your photography skills, whether you've been taking photos for years, or are just starting out. We'd love you to join if you have any interest in photography, are creative, or even if you just want to take better Instagram photos!We hope to create a community in which you can share your photos and your ideas, inciting discussions. Also, a place for you to socialise and make new friends! <3

guild_name: University of Liverpool’s Women’s Health Advocacy Society
short_description: Our society is a community that brings everyone together to a safe and comfortable environment to discuss women's reproductive health, raise awareness and fundraise for vital charities!
long_description: 🌸 UoL Women’s Health Advocacy Society At the UoL Women’s Health Advocacy, we’re very passionate about creating a supportive, empowering community for anyone affected by women’s health conditions — including Endometriosis, PCOS, Adenomyosis, Breast Cancer, and more. Our society is open to all students, whether you’re living with a condition, supporting someone who is, studying health-related subjects, or simply want to learn, raise awareness, and make a difference. 💬 What We Do: Awareness Campaigns – Shedding light on underrepresented women’s health issues through talks, panels, and social media. Support & Community Events – Safe spaces to share experiences, discuss challenges, and connect with others who understand. Fundraising Initiatives – Raising money for women’s health charities and research foundations that drive real change. Workshops & Guest Speakers – Learn from health professionals, advocates, and people with lived experience. Socials & Collaborations – Meet like-minded people, collaborate with other societies, and build a strong, supportive network (& also have fun events!) 💗 Our Mission: To create a space space on campus, so that people can promote open conversations about women's health, raise awareness, empower women and allies — because every voice matters, and every story deserves to be heard. Check out our instagram for more updates (events, fundraising & more about the committee!)

short_description: Welcome to the UoL Fashion Society!
long_description: 'Into fashion? Let's go for coffee while we share tips and make new friends. Giving fashion lovers a safe place to create and express themselves while learning new skills and meeting other incredible clothes connoisseurs!

short_description: Vine Court Halls’ Student Committee (HSC) is a committee of students living in Vine, who will organise events and activities to make your time in Liverpool the best it can be.
long_description: You can get involved in your HSC by signing up on this page and emailing hsc@liverpool.ac.uk to let us know! Look out for your HSC's welcome meeting, which will take place on in the first week of term! HSC Training will take place on Wednesday 1st October - tickets will be listed here once they are available! Any questions? Email hsc@liverpool.ac.uk where the HSC team will get back to you as soon as possible!

short_description: We aim to unite all Welsh students from the University of Liverpool to celebrate Welsh culture and also connect with each other.
long_description: We aim to unite all Welsh students from the University of Liverpool to celebrate Welsh culture and also connect with each other. We aim to do this through meetings, socials, and cultural Welsh days (such as St Davids Day), watching sports fixtures and so much more! Any questions, get in contact! Instagram: livwelshsoc Email: welsh@society.liverpoolguild.org

Welcome to the Women in Business Society, or WiB, for short The Women in Business Society is a vibrant community dedicated to empowering and advancing women in the dynamic world of business. We aim to create a space where members can connect, collaborate, and thrive. Our society is committed to promoting gender equality, challenging biases, and championing diversity in the workplace. The Women in Business Society welcomes individuals from all backgrounds to join us in shaping a more inclusive and equitable future. All our info is posted on our socials! UPCOMING EVENTS Sip and Paint Date: March 5th Location: James E Brown Room @ The Guild Get ready for a creatively refreshing experience at our Sip and Paint: Candle Edition! Join us for an engaging evening where you’ll paint your candles while sipping on your favorite drink. Perfect for artists of all levels, this event is designed to unleash your creativity in a fun and relaxed atmosphere. 🕯️🍷 Tickets are out. Get them before they're gone! WiB x BDO: Opportunities and Industry Insights Date: March 13th Location: The Library @ The Guild Come along to hear directly from three current professionals at BDO in an exclusive careers panel. Discover what it’s like to work at BDO, explore opportunities in finance, and gain insider insight into the industry, followed by a live Q&A session! 🌟 WiB x BeFree Fundraising Run Date: March 14th Location: Sefton Park Lace up for our 5K run at Sefton Park! Run, jog, or walk, all levels are welcome as we come together to support BeFree Organisation. All donations are welcome! After which we head to Lark Lane for a little sweet treat 🥐

WELCOME TO WOMEN IN LAW SOCIETY! We are a new society for the 26/27 academic year dedicated to empowering women in law and promoting equality. We look forward to meeting all of you this year! Our society will provide a supportive network where aspiring legal professionals can build their confidence, develop skills and form connections. While our name highlights women, our space is open to anyone who faces gender-based barriers in law, including non-binary, trans, and gender-fluid students. We firmly believe that achieving gender equity in law requires everyone's involvement. We welcome allies of all genders to participate in our events and help us build a fairer legal industry.

short_description: A society to empower women in medical fields, and raise awareness of disparities women face within healthcare.
To provide a space for women and non-binary people interested in politics to connect, learn and socialise. To promote the inclusion of women and non-binary people in politics.
In the UK, despite women comprising 59% of medical students, only 16% advance to consultant surgeon roles.
The Womens' Community is for self-defining women students, and those whose gender identity includes woman all or some of the time.
Chinese culture at Liverpool, for anyone who wants in on the vibe. Festivals, Mandarin practice, and socials through the year. All are welcome!
long_description: The XJTLU Chinese Society was founded in 2009 by the first group of exchange students from Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University to come to Liverpool. It has since been recognised as the Guild's Society of the Year and is one of the largest Chinese societies in the city.We're open to everyone. You don't need to be Chinese nor do you need to speak Mandarin. Some of our members grew up with the language and culture, some are here because they like the community and vibe.We run our year around the festivals. Mid-Autumn in September, Lunar New Year in February, and informal Mandarin language exchange sessions through the term for anyone who wants to practise. Food at our events are inclusive (and delectable).Come and find us at the Welcome Fair!

short_description: We're the zoology society, a group dedicated to all things animal!
long_description: From fun trips and engaging guest lecturers to hands-on activities and impactful events, ZooSoc is the best place to explore the natural sciences in all its forms. We welcome students from all courses - whether you're a beginner or professional, the zoology society will bring you something new!
